description: Use when validating total IT spend against industry peers or building a software budget baseline for a CFO board presentation. Returns median monthly total software stack spend, category breakdown, and productivity tool medians by industry. Example: Mid-market healthcare org — median total SaaS spend $18,500/mo, EHR and clinical tools 41% of stack, productivity suite $2,800/mo — organizations above $26,000/mo are consolidation candidates. Source: Stratalize industry composite. $0.10 USDC per call.
name: get_industry_spend_benchmark
title: Get Industry Spend Benchmark
